fields.title: Column selection
fields.description: Select the column containing the collection value.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Replace input column
fields.description: Select this when the column containing the collection is to be removed from the output.

fields.title: Determine most specific type
fields.description:
The collection column often contains only general type information to the individual elements. Selecting
this option will determine the most specific type of the newly appended columns based on the actual content.
 If unsure, keep this option selected.

fields.title: Element count policy
fields.description: Select the policy on how to determine how many elements the input column contains.
